scientific_integrity: Full-spectrum analytic proof and exact rational independent checker; no claim of historical uniqueness or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Uniform baseline K_(a,b) conductances, one added same-part edge; a>=3, b>=1, w>0, discrete-time reversible walk. The unit-weight result is known (Hu-Kirkland 2019). General matrix methods may give alternative derivations; no independent audit.
title: A unique optimal edge conductance and a sharp Kemeny–Braess reversal on complete bipartite graphs
